subject: general
question: Who among the following was the Maharana of Mewar and composed a book on music called 'Sangeet Raj'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharana Kumbha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Maharana of Mewar** who composed a book on music called** 'Sangeet Raj'** was** Maharana Kumbha.**
 
• **Maharana Kumbha** was a great patron of art and culture and contributed significantly to the development of **music, dance, and literature in Mewar**.
 
• **'Sangeet Raj'** is a treatise on music that covers various aspects of Indian classical music, including the** theory of ragas, musical instruments, and the art of singing. **
 
• Maharana Kumbha was also a** prolific writer **and composed several works on** history, religion, and philosophy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharana Sanga **was the **ruler of Mewar** who fought against the **Mughal emperor Babur** in the** Battle of Khanwa in 1527**.
 
• **Maharana Pratap **was another famous ruler of Mewar who fought against the **Mughals in the Battle of Haldighati in 1576**.
 
• **Maharana Udai Singh** was the founder of **Udaipur** and the **father of Maharana Pratap.**
